why: Restores the state issue #664 was fought in: BASELINE-RED reports two integers and drops the names the harness already holds. The run still looks correct -- a count is printed, the status is right, nothing errors -- and every future occurrence becomes undiagnosable, which is exactly how three investigations reached 'not reproducible' and stopped. The information is free; discarding it is the defect.
killedBy: runOne baseline check (the scoped tests must be green BEFORE any mutation) NAMES the tests that failed, so a red baseline is diagnosable at all (issue #664)
